name: contact-book-plus
title: Contact Book Plus — Relationship Intelligence Substrate
description: Revival and evolution of the archived contact-book scenario (scenarios/swarm-manager/ideas/contact-book-archived/). Not a CRUD contact list — a structured relationship-memory substrate storing people, facts, relationships, consent-bounded metadata. Substrate for gift-purchase surfaces (the cleanest consumer-product monetization moment in the lifestyle bundle), future wedding planning, event recommendations, and relationship-aware downstream scenarios. First research sub-item audits what is salvageable from the archived attempt. Full vision and non-goals documented in the uploaded orchestration-summary.md.
